title: Rollmark chart block, version 1
description: Payload of a Rollmark `chart` fenced block. Describes a quantitative visualization semantically; the renderer owns all visual presentation (colors, fonts, spacing, animation, theme). Producers must preserve source data values exactly. This schema is the producer contract and forbids unknown properties; conforming renderers ignore unknown properties with a warning (SPEC.md §2.3). Two constraints are not expressible in JSON Schema and are validated separately: x.field and every series[].field must appear in at least one data row, and when x.type is "temporal" every x value must be an ISO 8601 date or date-time string.

version.description: Rollmark chart schema version. Must be 1.

summary.description: One- or two-sentence natural-language description of what the chart shows. Strongly encouraged: it is the text fallback for export targets, the accessible description for screen readers, and the fallback content if rendering fails. Must be consistent with the data.

field.description: Name of the data field providing x values.

label.description: Axis label. Defaults to the field name.

type.description: "category" (default) or "temporal". Temporal x values must be ISO 8601 date or date-time strings.

series.description: One entry per line or bar group. Field names must be unique across series.

field.description: Name of the data field providing y values for this series.

label.description: Series label shown in the legend. Defaults to the field name.

data.description: Inline data rows. Values referenced by x.field must be strings or numbers; values referenced by series[].field must be numbers or null (null renders as a gap, not zero). Rows may contain additional fields; renderers ignore them.
